title: Tiny, cute guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#e8873a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='26' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#ffc27a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- upper bout highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#f5a24d'/>
  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='8' fill='#5a2e10'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='10.5' fill='none' stroke='#c96a24' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='41' y='76' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a3c14'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='43' y='14' width='14' height='32' fill='#a35a22'/>
  <rect x='43' y='14' width='14' height='32' fill='none' stroke='#ffc27a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- frets -->
  <line x1='44' y1='22' x2='56' y2='22' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='30' x2='56' y2='30' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='38' x2='56' y2='38' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='42' y='6' width='16' height='10' rx='3' fill='#7a3c14'/>
  <rect x='42' y='6' width='16' height='10' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#ffc27a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tuners -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='9' r='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='9' r='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='14' r='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='14' r='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='46' y1='16' x2='46' y2='78' stroke='#f0f4ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#f0f4ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='16' x2='54' y2='78' stroke='#f0f4ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- cute face on body -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='58' r='2.2' fill='#3a1a06'/>
  <circle cx='43.7' cy='57.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffd9a0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='58' r='2.2' fill='#3a1a06'/>
  <circle cx='57.7' cy='57.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffd9a0'/>
  <path d='M46 61.5 Q50 64.5 54 61.5' fill='none' stroke='#3a1a06' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
